Counterstroke Maps

The seven maps of Kenneth Macksey’s The Counterstroke (B-GL-309-007/FT-001), redrawn on one sheet.

Grid squares are 1 km, numbered as on the original 1:100,000 sheet (Schwandorf, C 6738). Places with a grid reference in the narrative are placed from it; the others, and all unit positions, are read off the scanned maps and are accurate to about half a kilometre. Rivers and woods are simplified, and the course of the REGEN is approximate. Blue frames are Canadian, teal frames are US, and red diamonds are Fantasian.
